flashcard_questions.q: A macronutrient made up of chains of amino acids, essential for growth, repair, and maintenance of body tissues.
Nutrients needed in large amounts by the body — protein, carbohydrates, and fat.
Small organic molecules that link together in chains to form proteins — there are 20 found in food.

flashcard_questions.a: The eight amino acids the body cannot make and must obtain from food: isoleucine, leucine, lysine, methionine, phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan, and valine.
flashcard_questions.q: What is meant by 'essential amino acids'?

flashcard_questions.a: High biological value protein — contains all eight essential amino acids in sufficient quantities. Found in animal sources and soya.
flashcard_questions.q: What is meant by 'HBV (high biological value) proteins'?
